question: Swachh Bharat Mission was launched in year ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is__ ​2nd October 2014__.

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] Key Points__

__
 
• On 2 October 2014, the 'Swachh Bharat Mission was launched as a mass national movement across the country.
 
• Under this campaign, the target of realizing the vision of "Swachh Bharat" by 2 October 2019 had been set.
 
• Swachh Bharat Abhiyan is the most important cleanliness campaign undertaken by the Government of India.
 
• Shri Narendra Modi started the Swachh Bharat Mission in New Delhi, Rajpath.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] Additional Information__

 
• The central government had a target of constructing 10 crore toilets by 2019 under the Swachh Bharat Mission.
 
• This ambitious campaign is divided into two categories.
 
 
• These categories are - Swachh Bharat Abhiyan (Rural) and Swachh Bharat Abhiyan (Urban)
 
• The Namami Gange project is a huge mission to clean the mother Ganga under the Swachh Bharat Abhiyan.
